name: o48516
description:
Dear Team,

The current deployment is operating with 16 cores active, while the system is capable of scaling up to a maximum of 64 cores as needed. Our DVID datastore is configured to use BoltDB, and the overall software version running on the cluster is 1.4.2. According to the monitoring tools, the server has been up for 12 days, 8 hours, 34 minutes without interruption.

For storage, we rely on a Ceph backend paired with the RBD driver, providing the necessary performance and reliability for our workloads. Please let me know if any adjustments are required.
